author: Stuart Sowerby
name: Fuji Film Simulation Profiles (X-Trans III)
description: Fifteen HaldCLUTs by Stuart Sowerby emulating the in-camera film simulations of Fujifilm X-Trans III cameras: Provia, Velvia, Astia, Classic Chrome, Pro Neg Hi and Std, Sepia, and the Acros and Mono black-and-white simulations with their green, red and yellow filter variants. Designed to be applied to a neutral image before other tonal adjustments.
